name: The Original Bourbon Creme Biscuit with Chocolate
ingredients_raw: Wheat flour, Sugar (34%), Bakery shortening [Palm oil, Interesterified fat (Palm), sesame oil], Corn starch, Colour (Caramel I & IV), Cocoa powder (2.8%), Whey powder, Raising agents (Sodium bicarbonate, Ammonium bicarbonate), Artificial flavouring substances (Vanillin, milky cocoa & chocolate), Emulsifiers (Mono - and di-glycerides of fatty acids, Soya lecithin), Milk chocolate (0.1%) (Contains milk) and lodized salt Contains: Wheat (gluten), Sesame, Milk products and Soy
